Testcase Name: Create text post with valid text
Testcase Objective: Verify user can create a text-only Buzz post with valid content.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Enter valid text in post box (e.g. Happy Friday everyone) | 4. Select post type as text | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post is created successfully and appears at the top of the Buzz feed with entered text, author name, and timestamp.

Testcase Name: Create text post with empty text
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a text post submitted without any text.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Leave post text field empty | 4. Select post type as text | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Validation error is shown (text is required) and post is not created.

Testcase Name: Create text post with text at max boundary length (65530 chars)
Testcase Objective: Verify a text post with text exactly at the 65530 character maximum length is accepted.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Enter text of exactly 65530 characters | 4. Select post type as text | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post is created successfully without truncation or error.

Testcase Name: Create text post exceeding max length (65531 chars)
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects text post content exceeding the 65530 character limit.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Enter text of 65531 characters | 4. Select post type as text | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Validation error is shown and post is not created.

Testcase Name: Create post with invalid type value
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a post submitted with a type value outside of text, photo, and video.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Send create post request with type=audio | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns a validation error since type is not in the allowed list (text, photo, video).

Testcase Name: Create text post with special characters and emoji
Testcase Objective: Verify a text post containing special characters and emoji is stored and displayed correctly.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Enter text with emoji and special characters (e.g. Great job! plus emoji and hashtag) | 4. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post is created and text renders exactly as entered, including emoji and special characters.

Testcase Name: Create text post with only whitespace text
Testcase Objective: Verify system behavior when post text contains only spaces.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Enter only spaces as text | 4. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post text is either rejected as invalid or trimmed per business rule; whitespace-only content should not bypass required-field validation.

Testcase Name: Create photo post with 1 valid image
Testcase Objective: Verify user can create a Buzz post with a single valid photo attachment.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as photo | 4. Upload one valid JPG image under 2MB | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post is created successfully with the photo displayed in the feed.

Testcase Name: Create photo post with 5 valid images (max allowed)
Testcase Objective: Verify user can attach the maximum allowed 5 photos to a single post.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as photo | 4. Upload 5 valid images (jpg png or gif) each under 2MB | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post is created successfully with all 5 photos attached and displayed.

Testcase Name: Create photo post with 6 images (exceeds max)
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a photo post when more than 5 photos are attached.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as photo | 4. Upload 6 valid images | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Validation error is returned for the photos field and post is not created.

Testcase Name: Create photo post with zero photos (empty array)
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a photo-type post submitted with no photos attached.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Send create post request with type=photo and photos as an empty array | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: Validation error is returned since the photos array must not be empty for a photo post.

Testcase Name: Create photo post with unsupported file type
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects photo uploads whose MIME type or extension is not in the allowed list (gif jpeg jpg jfif png).
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as photo | 4. Attempt to upload a .bmp or .pdf file | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Validation error is shown indicating unsupported file type and post is not created.

Testcase Name: Create photo post with image exceeding 2MB size limit
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a photo attachment larger than the 2MB (2097152 byte) maximum allowed size.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as photo | 4. Upload an image file larger than 2MB | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Validation error is shown indicating the file exceeds the maximum allowed size and post is not created.

Testcase Name: Create photo post with image exactly at 2MB boundary
Testcase Objective: Verify a photo attachment exactly at the 2097152 byte size limit is accepted.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as photo | 4. Upload an image file of exactly 2097152 bytes | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Photo is accepted and post is created successfully.

Testcase Name: Create photo post with filename exceeding 100 characters
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a photo whose filename exceeds the 100 character maximum length.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as photo | 4. Upload an image with a filename longer than 100 characters | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Validation error is returned and post is not created.

Testcase Name: Create video post with valid YouTube URL
Testcase Objective: Verify a Buzz post can be created using a valid YouTube video URL.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as video | 4. Enter a valid YouTube URL (e.g. youtube.com/watch?v=abc12345678) | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post is created successfully and the video is embedded, with the link converted to https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id> format.

Testcase Name: Create video post with valid Vimeo URL
Testcase Objective: Verify a Buzz post can be created using a valid Vimeo video URL.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as video | 4. Enter a valid Vimeo URL (e.g. vimeo.com/123456789) | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post is created successfully and the video link is converted to the embedded player.vimeo.com/video/ URL.

Testcase Name: Create video post with valid Dailymotion URL
Testcase Objective: Verify a Buzz post can be created using a valid Dailymotion video URL.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as video | 4. Enter a valid Dailymotion URL (e.g. dailymotion.com/video/x7abcde) | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post is created successfully and the video link is converted to the embedded dailymotion.com/embed/video/ URL.

Testcase Name: Create video post with unsupported domain URL
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects video URLs from domains other than YouTube Vimeo or Dailymotion.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as video | 4. Enter a non-supported video URL (e.g. a Facebook or generic video link) | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Validation error is shown for the link field and post is not created.

Testcase Name: Create video post with malformed YouTube URL
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a URL that contains youtube but does not match a valid YouTube video URL pattern.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as video | 4. Enter malformed URL such as https://www.youtube.com/ with no video id | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Validation error (Invalid YouTube URL) is returned and post is not created.

Testcase Name: Create video post with empty link field
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a video-type post submitted without a video link.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Send create post request with type=video and link left blank | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: Validation error is returned since link is required for the video post type.

Testcase Name: Create video post using an already-embedded YouTube URL
Testcase Objective: Verify system accepts a URL already in embedded format without modification.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Select post type as video | 4. Enter an already-embedded YouTube URL (https://www.youtube.com/embed/abc123) | 5. Click Post button
Expected Result: Post is created successfully and the embedded URL is stored as-is.

Testcase Name: Validate a valid YouTube short URL
Testcase Objective: Verify the link validation endpoint returns valid true for a correct YouTube URL.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/validation/links with url=https://youtu.be/abc12345678 | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response returns valid=true along with the generated embeddedURL in youtube.com/embed format.

Testcase Name: Validate a valid Vimeo URL
Testcase Objective: Verify the link validation endpoint returns valid true for a correct Vimeo URL.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/validation/links with url=https://vimeo.com/123456789 | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response returns valid=true and embeddedURL in player.vimeo.com/video/ format.

Testcase Name: Validate a valid Dailymotion short (dai.ly) URL
Testcase Objective: Verify the link validation endpoint returns valid true for a correct Dailymotion short URL.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/validation/links with url=https://dai.ly/x7abcde | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response returns valid=true and embeddedURL in dailymotion.com/embed/video/ format.

Testcase Name: Validate URL from an unsupported domain
Testcase Objective: Verify the endpoint returns valid false for a URL that does not belong to YouTube Vimeo or Dailymotion.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/validation/links with url=https://www.example.com/video/1 | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response returns valid=false with url and embeddedURL fields set to null.

Testcase Name: Validate request missing required url query parameter
Testcase Objective: Verify request fails validation when the required url query parameter is not supplied.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/validation/links without a url parameter | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: API returns a validation error (400) indicating url is required.

Testcase Name: Validate malformed Vimeo URL containing keyword but invalid pattern
Testcase Objective: Verify the endpoint correctly flags a URL containing vimeo text but not matching a valid Vimeo pattern as invalid.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/validation/links with url=https://vimeo.com/notanumber | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response returns valid=false (Invalid Vimeo URL) since no numeric video ID could be extracted.

Testcase Name: View Buzz feed in default order
Testcase Objective: Verify the Buzz feed lists posts in descending order of creation time by default.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. Observe the list of posts
Expected Result: Posts are displayed with the most recently created or shared post at the top (sorted by share.createdAtUtc descending).

Testcase Name: Sort Buzz feed by number of likes
Testcase Objective: Verify the feed can be sorted by share.numOfLikes.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/feed?sortField=share.numOfLikes&sortOrder=DESC | 2. Inspect response order
Expected Result: Posts are returned ordered by number of likes in descending order.

Testcase Name: Sort Buzz feed by number of comments
Testcase Objective: Verify the feed can be sorted by share.numOfComments.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/feed?sortField=share.numOfComments&sortOrder=ASC | 2. Inspect response order
Expected Result: Posts are returned ordered by number of comments in ascending order.

Testcase Name: Paginate Buzz feed using limit and offset
Testcase Objective: Verify the feed supports pagination via limit and offset query parameters.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/feed?limit=5&offset=0 | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/feed?limit=5&offset=5 | 3. Compare results
Expected Result: Each call returns a distinct non-overlapping page of at most 5 posts and meta.total reflects the total post count.

Testcase Name: View Buzz feed with invalid sortField value
Testcase Objective: Verify the feed rejects a sortField value that is not in the allowed list.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/feed?sortField=invalidField | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: API returns a validation error since sortField is not one of the allowed values (share.createdAtUtc, share.numOfLikes, share.numOfComments).

Testcase Name: Get a post by valid ID with default model
Testcase Objective: Verify a single post can be retrieved by its ID using the default model.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/posts/{id} for an existing post | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: Post details are returned matching the default BuzzPostModel structure.

Testcase Name: Get a post by valid ID with detailed model
Testcase Objective: Verify a single post can be retrieved with the detailed feed-post model including likes and comments summary.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/posts/{id}?model=detailed | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: Post details are returned matching the detailed BuzzFeedPostModel, including comment/like counts and the current user's like status.

Testcase Name: Get a post with a non-existent ID
Testcase Objective: Verify system returns a record-not-found error when requesting a post ID that does not exist.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/posts/99999999 | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: API returns a 404 Record Not Found error.

Testcase Name: Edit own text post with valid new text
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can successfully edit the text of their own Buzz post.
Steps: 1. Login as the ESS user who authored a text post | 2. Navigate to Buzz feed | 3. Click Edit on own post | 4. Update the text content | 5. Save changes
Expected Result: Post is updated successfully and the new text is displayed in the feed.

Testcase Name: Attempt to edit another employee's post
Testcase Objective: Verify a regular ESS user cannot edit a Buzz post authored by another employee.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user A | 2. Call PUT /api/v2/buzz/posts/{id} for a post authored by employee B | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 403 Forbidden and the post remains unchanged.

Testcase Name: Edit text post exceeding max length (65531 chars)
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects an edit request where the updated text exceeds the 65530 character limit.
Steps: 1. Login as post owner | 2. Edit own text post | 3. Enter text of 65531 characters | 4. Save changes
Expected Result: Validation error is returned and post is not updated.

Testcase Name: Attempt to change post type from text to video during edit
Testcase Objective: Verify system prevents changing a post's type from text to video through the edit operation.
Steps: 1. Login as owner of a text post | 2. Call PUT /api/v2/buzz/posts/{id} with type=video and a link value | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns an invalid-parameter error and the post type remains text; text posts cannot be converted to video posts.

Testcase Name: Add new photos to an existing photo post within limit
Testcase Objective: Verify additional photos can be added to an existing photo post as long as the total stays within 5.
Steps: 1. Login as owner of a photo post with 2 existing photos | 2. Edit the post | 3. Add 2 more valid photos | 4. Save changes
Expected Result: Post is updated with 4 total photos displayed.

Testcase Name: Delete specific photos from an existing photo post
Testcase Objective: Verify specific photos can be removed from a post via the deletedPhotos parameter.
Steps: 1. Login as owner of a photo post with 3 photos | 2. Edit the post and select 1 photo to delete | 3. Save changes
Expected Result: The selected photo is removed and the remaining 2 photos are still displayed.

Testcase Name: Add photos exceeding the 5-photo total limit on edit
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects adding photos when the resulting total (existing plus new minus deleted) would exceed 5.
Steps: 1. Login as owner of a photo post that already has 4 photos | 2. Attempt to add 3 more photos without deleting any | 3. Save changes
Expected Result: Validation error is returned and the photo set is not updated.

Testcase Name: Delete photo IDs that do not belong to the post
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a request to delete photo IDs that are not associated with the given post.
Steps: 1. Login as post owner | 2. Call PUT /api/v2/buzz/posts/{id} with deletedPhotos containing a photo ID from a different post | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns an invalid-parameter error and no photos are deleted.

Testcase Name: Edit video post link with a valid new video URL
Testcase Objective: Verify the video link of an existing video post can be updated to a new valid URL.
Steps: 1. Login as owner of a video post | 2. Edit the post | 3. Replace the link with a new valid YouTube Vimeo or Dailymotion URL | 4. Save changes
Expected Result: Post is updated and the new embedded video is displayed.

Testcase Name: Edit video post link with an invalid URL
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects updating a video post's link with an unsupported or invalid URL.
Steps: 1. Login as owner of a video post | 2. Edit the post | 3. Replace the link with an invalid/unsupported URL | 4. Save changes
Expected Result: Validation error is returned and the original video link remains unchanged.

Testcase Name: Attempt to change post type from video to photo during edit
Testcase Objective: Verify system prevents changing a video post's type to photo through the edit operation.
Steps: 1. Login as owner of a video post | 2. Call PUT /api/v2/buzz/posts/{id} with type=photo and a photos array | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns an invalid-parameter error and the post type remains video.

Testcase Name: Delete own post
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can delete their own Buzz post.
Steps: 1. Login as post owner | 2. Navigate to Buzz feed | 3. Click Delete on own post | 4. Confirm deletion
Expected Result: Post and its associated photos, comments, and likes are removed from the feed successfully.

Testcase Name: Attempt to delete another employee's post
Testcase Objective: Verify a regular ESS user cannot delete a Buzz post authored by another employee.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user A | 2. Call DELETE /api/v2/buzz/shares/{id} for a post authored by employee B | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 403 Forbidden and the post is not deleted.

Testcase Name: Delete a post with a non-existent share ID
Testcase Objective: Verify system returns an error when attempting to delete a post using an ID that does not exist.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call DELETE /api/v2/buzz/shares/99999999 | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns an invalid-parameter/not-found error and no data is changed.

Testcase Name: Admin deletes any employee's post
Testcase Objective: Verify a user with admin-level Buzz permissions can delete any employee's post.
Steps: 1. Login as Admin | 2. Navigate to Buzz feed | 3. Click Delete on a post authored by another employee | 4. Confirm deletion
Expected Result: Post is deleted successfully regardless of ownership, per admin data-group permissions.

Testcase Name: Add a valid comment to a post
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can add a comment to an existing Buzz post or share.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Open a post in the Buzz feed | 3. Enter comment text | 4. Click Comment/Submit
Expected Result: Comment is saved and displayed under the post; the post's comment count increases by 1.

Testcase Name: Add a comment with empty text
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a comment submitted with empty text.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Open a post | 3. Leave the comment field empty | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Validation error is returned and no comment is created.

Testcase Name: Add a comment exceeding max length (65531 chars)
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects comment text exceeding the 65530 character limit.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Open a post | 3. Enter comment text of 65531 characters | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Validation error is returned and comment is not created.

Testcase Name: Add a comment to a non-existent share ID
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects comment creation when the target shareId does not exist.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call POST /api/v2/buzz/shares/99999999/comments with valid text | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns an invalid-parameter error and no comment is created.

Testcase Name: Add comment at maximum boundary length (65530 chars)
Testcase Objective: Verify a comment with text exactly at the 65530 character limit is accepted.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Open a post | 3. Enter comment text of exactly 65530 characters | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Comment is created successfully without truncation.

Testcase Name: Verify comment count increments correctly with multiple comments
Testcase Objective: Verify the post's number-of-comments counter increases correctly with each new comment added.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Open a post with 0 comments | 3. Add 3 separate comments | 4. Refresh the post view
Expected Result: Comment count on the post displays 3 and all 3 comments are listed.

Testcase Name: Edit own comment with valid text
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can edit the text of their own comment.
Steps: 1. Login as comment author | 2. Open the post containing own comment | 3. Click Edit on the comment | 4. Update the text | 5. Save changes
Expected Result: Comment text is updated successfully and displayed with the updated content.

Testcase Name: Attempt to edit another employee's comment
Testcase Objective: Verify a regular ESS user cannot edit a comment authored by another employee.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user A | 2. Call PUT /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/comments/{commentId} for a comment authored by employee B | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 403 Forbidden and the comment remains unchanged.

Testcase Name: Edit comment with text exceeding max length
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects edited comment text exceeding the 65530 character limit.
Steps: 1. Login as comment author | 2. Edit own comment | 3. Enter text of 65531 characters | 4. Save changes
Expected Result: Validation error is returned and comment is not updated.

Testcase Name: Edit a comment that does not exist
Testcase Objective: Verify system returns a not-found error when editing a comment ID that does not exist.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call PUT /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/comments/99999999 with valid text | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns a 404 Record Not Found error.

Testcase Name: Delete own comment
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can delete their own comment from a post.
Steps: 1. Login as comment author | 2. Open the post containing own comment | 3. Click Delete on the comment | 4. Confirm deletion
Expected Result: Comment is removed and the post's comment count decreases by 1.

Testcase Name: Attempt to delete another employee's comment
Testcase Objective: Verify a regular ESS user cannot delete a comment authored by another employee.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user A | 2. Call DELETE /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/comments/{commentId} for a comment authored by employee B | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 403 Forbidden and the comment is not deleted.

Testcase Name: Delete a comment that does not exist
Testcase Objective: Verify system returns a not-found error when deleting a non-existent comment ID.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call DELETE /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/comments/99999999 | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns a 404 Record Not Found error.

Testcase Name: Admin deletes any employee's comment
Testcase Objective: Verify a user with admin-level Buzz comment permissions can delete any employee's comment.
Steps: 1. Login as Admin | 2. Open a post containing another employee's comment | 3. Click Delete on that comment | 4. Confirm deletion
Expected Result: Comment is deleted successfully and comment count decreases by 1, regardless of ownership.

Testcase Name: List all comments on a post in chronological order
Testcase Objective: Verify comments on a post are listed sorted by creation time (comment.createdAtUtc).
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/comments | 3. Inspect order of returned comments
Expected Result: Comments are returned in order of createdAtUtc with the correct total count.

Testcase Name: Paginate comments list using limit and offset
Testcase Objective: Verify the comments list supports pagination.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/comments?limit=2&offset=0 | 2. Call the same endpoint with offset=2 | 3. Compare results
Expected Result: Each call returns a distinct page of up to 2 comments and meta.total reflects the full comment count.

Testcase Name: List comments with detailed model parameter
Testcase Objective: Verify comments can be retrieved using the detailed model returning extended comment information.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/comments?model=detailed | 2. Inspect response structure
Expected Result: Response returns comments in the detailed BuzzDetailedCommentModel format including additional metadata such as like status.

Testcase Name: Like a post for the first time
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can like a Buzz post/share that they have not previously liked.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Open the Buzz feed | 3. Click the Like button on a post not yet liked by the user | 4. Observe result
Expected Result: Like is registered, the post's like count increases by 1, and the Like button changes to a Liked state.

Testcase Name: Attempt to like a post that is already liked
Testcase Objective: Verify system prevents a user from liking the same post twice.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user who has already liked a post | 2. Call POST /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/likes again for the same post | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 400 Bad Request with message Already liked and the like count does not increase further.

Testcase Name: Unlike a previously liked post
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can remove their like from a post they previously liked.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user who has liked a post | 2. Click the Unlike/Liked button on that post | 3. Observe result
Expected Result: Like is removed, the post's like count decreases by 1, and the button reverts to a Like state.

Testcase Name: Attempt to unlike a post that was never liked
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects an unlike request for a post the user has not liked.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user who has not liked a specific post | 2. Call DELETE /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/likes | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 400 Bad Request with message Not previously liked and no changes occur.

Testcase Name: List all users who liked a post
Testcase Objective: Verify the list of likes for a given post/share can be retrieved.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/shares/{shareId}/likes | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response returns the list of employees who liked the post along with the total like count.

Testcase Name: Like a post with a non-existent share ID
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a like request for a share ID that does not exist.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call POST /api/v2/buzz/shares/99999999/likes | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns an invalid-parameter error and no like is recorded.

Testcase Name: Like a comment for the first time
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can like a comment that they have not previously liked.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Open a post with a comment | 3. Click Like on the comment | 4. Observe result
Expected Result: Like is registered and the comment's like count increases by 1.

Testcase Name: Attempt to like a comment that is already liked
Testcase Objective: Verify system prevents a user from liking the same comment twice.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user who has already liked a comment | 2. Call POST /api/v2/buzz/comments/{commentId}/likes again | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 400 Bad Request with message Already liked and the like count remains unchanged.

Testcase Name: Unlike a previously liked comment
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can remove their like from a comment they previously liked.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user who has liked a comment | 2. Click Unlike on the comment | 3. Observe result
Expected Result: Like is removed and the comment's like count decreases by 1.

Testcase Name: Attempt to unlike a comment that was never liked
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects an unlike request for a comment the user has not liked.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user who has not liked a specific comment | 2. Call DELETE /api/v2/buzz/comments/{commentId}/likes | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 400 Bad Request with message Not previously liked.

Testcase Name: List all likes on a comment sorted by liked date
Testcase Objective: Verify likes on a comment can be listed and sorted by likedAtUtc.
Steps: 1. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/comments/{commentId}/likes?sortField=commentLike.likedAtUtc&sortOrder=DESC | 2. Inspect response order
Expected Result: Likes are returned ordered by most recently liked first, with the correct total count.

Testcase Name: Share an existing post without additional text
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can re-share an existing post to the feed without adding extra text.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Open a post in the feed | 3. Click Share | 4. Leave caption text empty | 5. Submit share
Expected Result: A new share entry (type=share) referencing the original post is created and appears in the feed under the sharing employee.

Testcase Name: Share an existing post with additional caption text
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can re-share an existing post along with their own caption text.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Open a post in the feed | 3. Click Share | 4. Enter caption text | 5. Submit share
Expected Result: A new share entry is created with the caption text displayed alongside the original shared post content.

Testcase Name: Share a post using a non-existent shareId
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects a share request referencing a shareId that does not exist.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call POST /api/v2/buzz/shares with shareId=99999999 | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns an invalid-parameter error and no share is created.

Testcase Name: Share a post with caption text exceeding max length
Testcase Objective: Verify system rejects share caption text exceeding the 65530 character limit.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Attempt to share a post with caption text of 65531 characters | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: Validation error is returned and the share is not created.

Testcase Name: List all shares/reposts of a given post
Testcase Objective: Verify all shares of a specific post can be retrieved via the post shares listing endpoint.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/posts/{id}/shares | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response returns all share records (type=share) referencing that post, with the correct total count.

Testcase Name: Multiple employees independently share the same post
Testcase Objective: Verify multiple different employees can each independently share the same original post.
Steps: 1. Login as Employee A and share Post X | 2. Login as Employee B and share the same Post X | 3. Verify the feed
Expected Result: Two separate share entries are created, both referencing the same original post, and each appears under its respective sharer's name in the feed.

Testcase Name: Edit own share's caption text
Testcase Objective: Verify a user can edit the caption text of their own re-shared post.
Steps: 1. Login as employee who shared a post with caption text | 2. Click Edit on own share | 3. Update caption text | 4. Save changes
Expected Result: Share caption text is updated successfully.

Testcase Name: Attempt to edit an original post via the shares edit endpoint
Testcase Objective: Verify system blocks editing an original post (type=post) through the /buzz/shares/{id} update endpoint.
Steps: 1. Login as post owner | 2. Call PUT /api/v2/buzz/shares/{id} where id refers to the original post's share record (type=post) | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns an invalid-parameter error, since original posts must be edited via /buzz/posts/{id}, not /buzz/shares/{id}.

Testcase Name: Attempt to edit another employee's share
Testcase Objective: Verify a regular ESS user cannot edit a re-share authored by another employee.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user A | 2. Call PUT /api/v2/buzz/shares/{id} for a share authored by employee B | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 403 Forbidden and the share remains unchanged.

Testcase Name: Delete own re-share without affecting the original post
Testcase Objective: Verify deleting a re-share (type=share) removes only that share entry and leaves the original post intact.
Steps: 1. Login as employee who re-shared a post | 2. Click Delete/Unshare on own share entry | 3. Confirm deletion | 4. Verify original post still exists in feed
Expected Result: Only the share record is deleted; the original post and other shares of it remain visible in the feed.

Testcase Name: Delete original post via the shares delete endpoint
Testcase Objective: Verify deleting a share record of type post removes the entire original post, cascading photos, comments, likes, and shares.
Steps: 1. Login as post owner | 2. Call DELETE /api/v2/buzz/shares/{id} where id is the original post's share record | 3. Confirm deletion
Expected Result: The original post and its associated content are permanently deleted, and any re-shares of it are also removed from the feed.

Testcase Name: Attempt to delete another employee's re-share
Testcase Objective: Verify a regular ESS user cannot delete or unshare a re-share entry created by another employee.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user A | 2. Call DELETE /api/v2/buzz/shares/{id} for a share authored by employee B | 3. Submit request
Expected Result: API returns 403 Forbidden and the share is not deleted.

Testcase Name: View upcoming work anniversaries within next 30 days
Testcase Objective: Verify employees whose joining-date anniversary falls within the next 0 to 30 days are listed.
Steps: 1. Login as ESS user | 2. Navigate to Buzz module | 3. View the Upcoming Anniversaries widget/feed
Expected Result: All employees whose work anniversary date (based on joinedDate) falls between today and 30 days from now are listed.

Testcase Name: Anniversary falling exactly today is included (0-day boundary)
Testcase Objective: Verify an employee whose anniversary date is exactly today (date difference equals 0) is included in the list.
Steps: 1. Set up an employee whose joinedDate month and day match today's date in a prior year | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/anniversaries | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: The employee is included in the anniversary list.

Testcase Name: Anniversary exactly 30 days away is included (upper boundary)
Testcase Objective: Verify an employee whose anniversary date is exactly 30 days from today is included in the results.
Steps: 1. Set up an employee whose anniversary date is exactly 30 days from today | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/anniversaries | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: The employee is included in the anniversary list since the date difference equals the max boundary of 30.

Testcase Name: Anniversary 31 days away is excluded
Testcase Objective: Verify an employee whose anniversary date is 31 days from today is excluded from the upcoming anniversaries list.
Steps: 1. Set up an employee whose anniversary date is 31 days from today | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/anniversaries | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: The employee is not included in the results, since 31 exceeds the maximum of 30 days.

Testcase Name: Employee who joined in the current year is excluded
Testcase Objective: Verify an employee whose joinedDate year equals the current year is excluded from the anniversary list since they have not completed a full year.
Steps: 1. Set up an employee who joined earlier this calendar year | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/anniversaries | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: The newly joined employee does not appear in the upcoming anniversaries list.

Testcase Name: Terminated or purged employees are excluded from anniversary list
Testcase Objective: Verify employees with a termination record or purged status are excluded from the upcoming anniversaries feed even if their anniversary date falls within range.
Steps: 1. Set up a terminated employee and a purged employee both with anniversary dates within the next 30 days | 2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/anniversaries | 3. Inspect response
Expected Result: Neither the terminated nor the purged employee appears in the results.
